description_en: Queries the custom service level agreement (SLA) rules of a task flow
description_zh: 调用此API可以获取自定义SLA规则列表
name: ListSLARules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

: To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

DagId.description_en: The ID of the task flow

Id.description_en: The ID of the SLA rule

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the task node

RuleType.description_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

0: an SLA rule for a task flow
1: an SLA rule for a task node
RuleType.description_zh:
规则类型：
0：任务流SLA规则。
1：任务节点SLA规则

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
